mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: conditions are clear at Verona Community Park under a New Moon. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 37 degrees, and the good news is that there is no rain predicted for the overnight hours.
Looking at our inbox and city updates, there is no new official news to report for the community this evening.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, keep an eye out for live music at Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, plus yoga, trivia, and pizza events scheduled throughout next week.
There were no reported incidents in this week's police department recap.
If you are craving something sweet, head over to Culver's before they close at 10:30 PM to enjoy today's flavor, which is Really Reese's.
